2609.02216.title: PEARL: Path-Entity Aligned Relational Learning with Contextual Subgraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Completion
2609.02216.paper_summary: Inductive knowledge graph completion (IKGC) aims to predict missing links involving entities unseen during training, requiring models to learn transferable relational and structural patterns. Existing subgraph- and path-based approaches often encode relational paths independently of their surrounding query subgraphs, although the predictive relevance of a path may vary across structural contexts. We propose PEARL, a Path-Entity Aligned Relational Learning framework that models paths as context-conditioned reasoning signals. PEARL constructs a query-specific contextual subgraph from the union of the query entities' neighborhoods and uses a large language model (LLM)-guided retriever to distill semantically relevant paths. It then builds a bipartite interaction graph over paths, contextual entities, and a global subgraph representation, allowing path embeddings to adapt to local and global structural evidence. To suppress noise introduced by the enlarged context, PEARL employs a dual-view contrastive objective that promotes representation consistency under stochastic contextual perturbations. Experiments on WN18RR, FB15k-237, and NELL-995 show that PEARL obtains the best average Hits@10 among the compared IKGC methods on all three benchmarks. Ablation studies, efficiency analyses, and case studies further validate the contributions of contextual subgraph modeling, semantic path retrieval, path-entity interaction, and contrastive regularization.
2609.02216.paper_summary_zh: 歸納知識圖譜補全（IKGC）旨在預測在訓練期間未見過的實體之間的缺失連結，這要求模型學習可轉移的關係和結構模式。現有的子圖和基於路徑的方法通常獨立於其周圍的查詢子圖編碼關係路徑，儘管路徑的預測相關性可能在不同的結構上下文中有所不同。我們提出了PEARL，一個路徑-實體對齊的關係學習框架，將路徑建模為上下文條件的推理信號。PEARL從查詢實體的鄰域聯合中構建一個查詢特定的上下文子圖，並使用大型語言模型（LLM）指導的檢索器來提煉語義相關的路徑。然後，它在路徑、上下文實體和全局子圖表示之間構建一個二分互動圖，允許路徑嵌入適應於局部和全局結構證據。為了抑制擴大上下文所引入的噪聲，PEARL採用了一種雙視圖對比目標，促進在隨機上下文擾動下的表示一致性。在WN18RR、FB15k-237和NELL-995上的實驗顯示，PEARL在所有三個基準中獲得了比較的IKGC方法中最佳的平均Hits@10。消融研究、效率分析和案例研究進一步驗證了上下文子圖建模、語義路徑檢索、路徑-實體互動和對比正則化的貢獻。
